local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local EMOTE_ID = "rbxassetid://507771019"

local function playEmote()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end

	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = humanoid
	end

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = EMOTE_ID

	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	track:Play()
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		playEmote()
	end
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local buyItemEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyItem")
if not buyItemEvent then
	buyItemEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyItemEvent.Name = "BuyItem"
	buyItemEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local ITEMS = {
	Sword = {
		Price = 100,
		Tool = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Sword"),
	},
}

local function giveItem(player, itemName)
	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return false
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		return false
	end

	if coins.Value < item.Price then
		return false
	end

	if not item.Tool then
		warn("Tool missing from ServerStorage: " .. itemName)
		return false
	end

	-- Prevent duplicate purchases
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	if (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(itemName)) or (character and character:FindFirstChild(itemName)) then
		return false
	end

	coins.Value -= item.Price

	local tool = item.Tool:Clone()
	tool.Parent = backpack

	return true
end

buyItemEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemName)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local success = giveItem(player, itemName)
	if not success then
		-- Optionally notify the client of failure
		-- buyItemEvent:FireClient(player, false, itemName)
	end
end)

	quantity = math.floor(quantity)
	if quantity < 1 then return end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then return end

	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	local potions = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then return end

	local totalCost = quantity * POTION_COST
	if coins.Value >= totalCost then
		coins.Value -= totalCost
		potions.Value += quantity
	end
end)

	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")

		if player.UserId == id then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false

	end

	if typeof(targetPlayer) ~= "Instance" or not targetPlayer:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end

		return
	end

		return
	end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create the RemoteEvent
local renamePetEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
renamePetEvent.Name = "RenamePet"
renamePetEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function sanitizeName(name)
	name = tostring(name or "")
	name = name:gsub("[%c%z]", "") -- strip control characters
	name = name:sub(1, 20) -- limit length
	if #name == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return name
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	-- Create the StringValue for the pet name
	local petName = Instance.new("StringValue")
	petName.Name = "PetName"
	petName.Value = "Pet"
	petName.Parent = player
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)

-- Handle players already in game (in case script runs late)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

renamePetEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, newName)
	local cleaned = sanitizeName(newName)
	if not cleaned then
		return
	end

	local petName = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if not petName then
		petName = Instance.new("StringValue")
		petName.Name = "PetName"
		petName.Parent = player
	end
	petName.Value = cleaned
end)

local CoinManager = {}

function CoinManager.addCoins(userId, amount)
	local key = "Player_" .. userId
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return PlayerDataStore:UpdateAsync(key, function(data)
			data = data or { coins = 0 }
			data.coins = (data.coins or 0) + amount
			return data
		end)
	end)

	if success and result then
		return result.coins
	else
		warn("Failed to add coins for userId " .. tostring(userId))
		return nil
	end
end

return CoinManager

		)
	end)

		warn("Failed to log inventory for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(errPost))
	end
end

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local function loadData(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return dataStore:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if success and data then
		coins.Value = data
	else
		coins.Value = 0
	end
end

local function saveData(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end
	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		return
	end

	local data = coins.Value
	for attempt = 1, 3 do
		local success, err = pcall(function()
			dataStore:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, data)
		end)
		if success then
			return
		end
		warn(("Save attempt %d failed for %s: %s"):format(attempt, player.Name, tostring(err)))
		task.wait(2)
	end
	warn(("Failed to save data for %s"):format(player.Name))
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(loadData)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveData)

game:BindToClose(function()
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		task.spawn(saveData, player)
	end
	-- Wait until all saves finish (or timeout)
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end)
